summary: Tested RISEDUAL MooMoo Hybrid Option 2 bridge end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 unit tests pass (tests/test_moomoo_bridge_health.py), 6/6 new API integration tests pass (tests/test_moomoo_bridge_api.py) — /moomoo-bridge/health, /smoke-test, /endpoint all correctly return 200 as owner and 401/403 unauth; DISCONNECTED baseline + FAIL-at-tunnel smoke confirmed. Adapter gate verified via `python -c` import: submit_equity at DISCONNECTED returns error='moomoo_not_execution_ready:DISCONNECTED'. Public.com executor is fully independent — 0 MooMoo cross-references in public_equity_live_executor.py. Frontend: after skipping onboarding tour and opening Admin Panel → Alpha DayTrader tab, ConnectMoomooCard renders with data-testid=moomoo-bridge-card. State banner shows 'DISCONNECTED', rung [moomoo-rung-connected] present, smoke-test button click renders [moomoo-smoke-result] with 'FAIL at tunnel', config drawer opens, host/port/exec-ready fields fill, Save closes drawer with no errors.
critical_code_review_comments: moomoo_bridge_health.py: read-only smoke test correctly never touches submit paths — confirmed by test_smoke_test_never_submits fixture that stubs adapter.submit_equity with AssertionError.
moomoo_broker_adapter.submit_equity places the readiness gate BEFORE any watchdog/notional/RTH checks — good defense-in-depth ordering.
Endpoint override route writes to os.environ only (not .env) and calls moomoo_broker_adapter.close() to force ctx reopen — correct runtime override without persistence side effects.
compute_health() is monotonic and non-raising (all probes wrapped) — behaves as documented.
seed_data_creation: None. Endpoint override applied host=127.0.0.1 port=11111 canary=SPY execution_ready=false (transient env vars only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OpenD daemon is intentionally not running in the pod — DISCONNECTED / FAIL-at-tunnel is the correct baseline. Frontend requires (1) login, (2) dismissing OnboardingTour ('Skip Tour'), (3) opening user-menu dropdown, (4) clicking nav-admin-btn, (5) clicking admin-tab-alpha-daytrader before ConnectMoomooCard is visible. The tour overlay silently intercepts pointer events if not dismissed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found; all backend + frontend flows behave per spec.
